blocks.text: Bring life back to your windows, fast. Wet & Forget Window & Screen Cleaner lifts away built-up grime, helping your glass and screens look clearer and more refreshed in just minutes. Unlike traditional window washing kits that require ladders, scrubbing, and multiple tools, this window cleaner spray allows you to clean up to 36 windows without removing screens *coverage dependant upon application volume. The powerful, yet gentle spray glass cleaner formula ensures water sheets off glass for a scrub free shine while minimizing water spots *different water quality may affect final result. Designed for efficiency, this full crystal window cleaner reaches up to 30 feet, making it perfect for second-story windows and hard-to-reach areas. Whether you need a glass cleaner for tough grime or an easy-to-use window cleaner tool for routine maintenance, Wet & Forget gets the job done with no extra effort. Simply attach to your hose, spray, rinse, and enjoy crystal-clear windows with zero scrubbing. The leak-resistant, reusable nozzle ensures controlled use, making it a convenient and reliable solution for homeowners. Say goodbye to frustrating, time-consuming cleaning and upgrade to the best glass cleaner for outdoor windows and screens today!

items.label: SIMPLE WINDOW & SCREEN CLEANING
items.value: The NEW Wet & Forget Outdoor Window and Screen Cleaner, use with your garden hose to dissolving dirt & grime in minutes. No need for ladders or heavy scrubbing—just spray, rinse, and enjoy clearer, brighter views.

items.label: POWERFUL & TIME-SAVING
items.value: Clean up to 36 windows per bottle and reach up to 30 feet! This window cleaner tool is perfect for second-story windows and hard-to-reach areas, making outdoor cleaning quick, safe, and hassle-free. *Coverage is dependant upon application volume.

items.label: NO NEED TO REMOVE SCREENS
items.value: Unlike traditional window washing kits, this sudsing glass cleaner cleans both windows and screens at the same time dissolving dirt and grime. The powerful formula features a unique sheeting action that minimizes water spotting, delivering a superior scrub-free shine.

items.label: MAXIMUM COVERAGE, MINIMAL EFFORT
items.value: For a superior scrub-free shine we reccomend using Wet & Forget Window & Screen Cleaner on cool windows not in direct sunlight. This spray glass cleaner eliminates the need for extra tools or manual scrubbing. *Different water quality may affect final results.

items.label: REUSABLE & LESS WASTE
items.value: Included Hose End sprayer fits both bottles for a cleaner planet and fewer parts to toss. Designed for controlled use, the hose-end nozzle ensures high-reaching and efficient application.

items.label: Special Features
items.value: All Purpose, Screen Cleaner, Scrub Free, Window Cleaner
